overview: The Marshall Islands is a country of coral atolls and islands in the North Pacific. Its capital is Majuro. Run by the United States after the Second World War, it became independent in 1986 and keeps close ties with the US. In the 1940s and 1950s the United States tested nuclear weapons at Bikini and Enewetak atolls.

geography.text: The country is made up of 29 atolls and 5 single islands, arranged in two roughly parallel chains. The land is low and flat, mostly only a few metres above sea level, and Kwajalein atoll encloses one of the largest lagoons in the world.
